measurements.what: Secure stack high-water mark under the double signature, which decides whether a 75,176-byte RAM copy of the atlas fits
measurements.needs: open bench board with a debug port

new_defects.what: enter_mnemonic returns on the idle timeout without zeroizing `indices`, the array of BIP-39 word indices typed so far (up to 23 words of the seed); the two other exits of the same function do zeroize it (lines 811 and 815). This is on the shipping restore path; the typed-prefix buffer in enter_single_word (line 851) is likewise never wiped.

This full-panel clear, documented as 'Clear the panel (before the legacy glyph blitter paints again)', has no caller anywhere. So when the atlas stops verifying after a pixel frame was shown, the next paint falls back to the 16x4 blitter (secure/src/ui/lcd.rs:160), which repaints only the 64 glyph cells (about 38 percent of the panel) and leaves the previous pixel frame, which can be a seed page, visible between them until the next boot. ui-px builds only; reasoned from the code, not run.
